parameters.name: ApiPath
parameters.description:
The custom part of the API calling address. This value serves as the API resource identifier and must be globally unique.

> The first part of the API calling address is generated by the system.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the API. The name must be globally unique. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), parentheses, and spaces. The name cannot exceed 20 characters in length.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: OriginSql
parameters.description:
The original SQL statement corresponding to the API, which specifies the SQL style for data development.

For example, `select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = 1`. In this example, `${system.device}` is the device table of IoT Platform. For more information, see the table description in [Data tables](~~120902~~).

sub_parameters.name: Example
sub_parameters.description: The example value of the parameter.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The parameter name.

For example, for a template parameter in the format of `${status}`, the parameter name is `status`.

sub_parameters.name: Required
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the parameter is required.

- true: required.
- false: not required.

Default value: true.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description: The parameter type. For more information, see [JDBCType](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html). Only the following types are supported: ARRAY, VARCHAR, INTEGER, BIGINT, BOOLEAN, DECIMAL, and TIMESTAMP.

sub_parameters.name: Example
sub_parameters.description: The example value of the parameter.

sub_parameters.name: Required
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the parameter is required.

- true: required.
- false: not required.

> For response parameters, you do not need to configure this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description: The parameter type. For more information, see [JDBCType](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html). Only the following types are supported: VARCHAR, INTEGER, BIGINT, BOOLEAN, DECIMAL, and TIMESTAMP.

parameters.name: TemplateSql
parameters.description:
The template SQL statement of the service, which is the templatized version of the original SQL statement.

For example, `select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = ${status}`. In this example, `${status}` is a templatized parameter. You can set template parameters to dynamic values.
